versions.changelog:
Initial release of browser-mcp-agent, providing real-browser control with persistent, fingerprinted sessions for agent automation.

- Enables agents to launch, navigate, click, fill forms, extract text, run JS, take screenshots, and stream browser screens over MCP tool calls using a real, kernel-level device fingerprint (not headless/patch-based).
- Sessions persist across runs, maintaining logins and a consistent device profile for sites.
- No need to write Playwright/SDK code; supports Node (npx) and Python, with install instructions for both.
- Intended for authorized, legitimate use only; not for unauthorized access or bypassing platform policies.
- Strong guidance on secure deployment: pin exact versions, keep secrets out of configs, and understand the supply-chain and security implications of deploying the closed-source browser kernel.
- Compatible with Windows (x64), macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon), Linux (x64, arm64), and Docker, excluding Alpine/musl.
